notes: Digital mixing control surface (24-fader, 6-layer dLive C Class surface). Physical I/O confirmed verbatim from Allen & Heath's official "dLive C3500 Technical Datasheet" PDF, cross-checked against A&H's dLive Surfaces comparison page (both list 6 mic/line in, 6 line out, 1 AES3 in, 1 AES3 out). The C3500 carries only a modest local analogue/digital I/O complement itself; full system channel count comes from a separate dLive MixRack (DM32/48/64 or CDM32/48/64) connected via the "GigaACE" EtherCon gigabit link, plus optional DX/GX expanders via the EtherCon "DX link" (up to 32x32ch @ 96kHz) — I/O living on that separate MixRack/expander hardware is not included here. An internal "I/O Port - 128ch @ 96kHz" expansion-card bay (for optional MADI/Dante/Waves SoundGrid/EtherSound/ACE cards) is omitted from the port list since its physical connector depends on the card fitted. Datasheet lists wordclock only as "BNC I/O" without an explicit in/out split; represented here as one BNC in + one BNC out (conventional arrangement) — flagged as inferred. Video output connector type is not stated in the datasheet; HDMI assumed by analogy with other current Allen & Heath consoles (Avantis/SQ) — unconfirmed. Exact USB sub-type not stated; USB-A assumed (standard for front-panel flash-drive record/playback on this class of console). No grade found/applicable for USB or video ports so grade omitted. Desktop control surface, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. No AES50 ports (that is a Behringer/Midas protocol, not used by dLive).
